The hidden cost of fine-pitch rework

Fine-pitch BGA rework cannot be aligned by eye

As ball pitch shrinks, hand alignment stops working. The SR-430A answers with CCD optics, laser position and profile-controlled heat.

Fine pitch defeats the eye

At 0.3–0.5 mm pitch, a fraction of a degree of rotation bridges or misses balls. Eyes cannot hold that tolerance.

Rotated chips fail silently

A chip rotated 1–2° places fine-pitch balls off-pad — and the failure appears only at test.

Heat imbalance burns boards

Uneven heating on multilayer boards lifts pads and warps the laminate during rework.

Desolder is a two-hand risk

Removing a BGA by hand risks lifting pads and damaging adjacent components.

Rework consumes the margin

Every failed attempt costs the board and the cycle time — thin margins disappear on the rework bench.

Audits demand proof

EMS customers want documented rework: curves, profiles and placement evidence.

Installation guide

From unpacking to first rework in five steps

Installation and operator training are included free with the SR-430A.

01 · Bench & layout

Place the station on a stable workbench with clearance around the moving head. Provide fume extraction or ventilation above the working area.

02 · Utilities

Connect 220 VAC ±10% mains (single phase, ~5–8 kW depending on model). The vacuum pump and cooling fans are built in; no compressed air is required.

03 · Profiles & calibration

Set the reflow profile (rising and activity temperature segments) per BGA type, verify with the K-type thermocouple, and store the curve.

04 · Trial rework

Rework scrap boards first — check alignment, temperature balance (≤2 °C verified on the SM-650) and placement accuracy before production boards.

05 · Training & ramp

Free installation and operator training included; 24/7 worldwide support and 1-day spare-part lead time after handover.

Technical evaluation FAQ

Questions buyers ask before ordering

How does the optical alignment work?

The CCD color optical system with beam split and zoom projects a magnified view of the BGA balls and board pads, with laser position and joystick control for fine adjustment. Placement resolution is 0.01 mm, and the PCB does not need to move after alignment.

What sizes can it handle?

PCBs from 85×85 mm up to 410×370 mm, and BGA packages from 2×2 mm up to 80×80 mm.

Can it both remove and replace chips?

Yes — the 2-in-1 design performs automatic desoldering and automatic soldering with 360° rotation nozzles and vacuum pickup, so one station completes the whole rework loop.

How is temperature controlled?

Three independently controlled heaters (top 1200 W, bottom 1200 W, IR 2700 W; total 5300 W) with K-type closed-loop thermocouple control at ±3 °C accuracy and software curve analysis.

Is it safe for production use?

Yes — CE certified with over-temperature protection that powers off automatically, password-protected parameters and an emergency stop.

How do I get a quote and process recommendation?

Email info@smthelp.com or WhatsApp +86 136 0256 2576 with your board samples or drawings, package sizes and rework volume. Configuration, quotation and profile strategy are provided within 24 hours.
